_readme: Every user-facing string in English. JSON rather than TS on purpose: scripts/generate-brand-assets.mjs runs in plain Node and reads this same file, so the Open Graph card and the page cannot drift apart. Keys must match ja.json — src/locales/index.ts types both as one shape. Asset paths and layout live in src/data/mocks/home.ts.
_stats_readme: hero.stats labels must stay unique: <HeroStats> keys its cards by label. The values are placeholders awaiting real figures — fill them in or drop the section rather than inventing numbers.
